dedupe_keys.name: shafts reference building height and footprint data for 46 cities

description: The SHAFTS study authors publish reference building-height and footprint datasets for 46 cities worldwide. They support development and assessment of the SHAFTS mapping package and can provide comparison inputs for other urban exposure models. Separate archive entries contain building-height and footprint products at 100, 250, 500 and 1000 metre resolution. A snapshot also preserves the original reference datasets and related repository material. The 27 May 2022 release adds eight ArcGIS Hub cities to an earlier 38-city collection; it does not establish one common observation year for every source city. Zenodo offers the products as ZIP files free under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is geographically selective coverage and differing source-data vintages. Users should inspect the preserved source documentation before treating the collection as consistent ground truth. The separate SHAFTS G5 software draft describes the prediction workflow. No directly related existing catalogue record was established. Only archive metadata and file names were checked; the datasets were not downloaded.
